lines.en: One stretch of leaf takes me half a day.
Many feet, very steady.
Green leaves are my road.
Holes follow where I crawl.
Don't move me to the ground.
Off the leaves I'd starve.
I nibble my way along.

lines.zh: 叶子的边缘是我的餐桌
lines.en: The leaf edge is my table.

lines.zh: 我爬得很慢，但一直在吃
lines.en: Slow, but always eating.

lines.zh: 这一片叶子，我吃了三天
lines.en: I've eaten this leaf for three days.
Soft body, strong grip.
I avoid the veins, eating only the flesh.
One more bite and I grow.

lines.zh: 平原的树上全是我的同类
lines.en: These plains trees are full of my kin.
Silk is left where I crawl.
I rest still on the leaf's back.
I'm getting fatter.
The leaf's sap is sweet.
When I've eaten enough, I'll spin a cocoon.
This is high up; don't fall.
My body is in segments.
Birds call above; I hide.
The underside of the leaf is cooler.
I need no water; the leaf is enough.
I rest between the veins.
A few more bites and I'll change.
My color matches the leaf.
Don't put me on stone.
I only need leaves.
Your hand is huge.
I'll cling to your sleeve.
There are leaves up there; put me up.
My eating isn't pretty; don't mind.
Look at the marks on my back.
I don't bite people, only leaves.
Slowly now; I crawl slowly.
I curled into a ball.
I crumpled the leaf I was clinging to.
I can't take this wound.
My silk snapped.
I dropped to the other half of the leaf.
I'll climb back up.
My body is trembling.
Now I dare not move.
I must eat faster to recover.
Leaves? Give me leaves.
This one's tender; I like it.

lines.zh: 你手里的叶子闻起来不错
lines.en: The leaf in your hand smells good.
Put me on it; I'll eat.
Not flowers; I don't eat flowers.
Only tree leaves for me.

lines.zh: 把叶子放到我嘴边，别抖。
lines.en: Put the leaf by my mouth and hold still.
This one lasts until I cocoon.
Slower; I can't grip.
Don't shake it; I'd fall.
You touched me and I curled up.
I'm soft; bumping doesn't hurt.

lines.zh: 叶子晃了一下，我差点掉
lines.en: The leaf shook; I nearly fell.
You pressed the leaf.
I held on; it's fine.
Don't pinch me between two fingers.

lines.zh: 我被推了一下，往前挪了半寸
lines.en: I was pushed half an inch forward.
I'm used to such tremors.
My silk still sticks to the leaf.
If you let go, I drop.
I'm still eating.
Talk to me after the cocoon.
At this stage I only eat.
Leaves matter more than this.
I can barely crawl.
My appetite would frighten you.
Let me grow first.
There's more than one of me on this tree.

lines.zh: 等我化了蛹，就是别的事了
lines.en: Once I pupate, it's another matter.
Don't interrupt my leaf.
I hug it with my front legs.
I bite this one and drag it.
The leaf is too heavy.
I pin it beneath me.
Don't take it; this is mine.
I eat bite by bite; no need to carry.
Silk can hold it.
Fallen leaves; I won't eat those.
This will last a long while.
I'll take a bite.
My teeth are tiny, though.
I raise my head and arch my body.
Don't move me.
This leaf is mine.
I really will bite.

lines.zh: 谁踩响了叶子，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone just crunched a leaf—I heard it.

lines.zh: 叶子那头一动，我就抬起头。
lines.en: Something moves across the leaf and I raise my head.
I watch you and arch up slowly.
I'm slow, but I bite.
You're blocking the leaf.
Don't grab me with your hand.
I curl up when touched.
If you hold still, I'll forget you.
I haven't eaten enough.
This bite is a warning.
The leaf matters more than this.
My front legs grip your finger.
Hardly any force at all.
My bristles pricked you.
You shook; I flew off.
That hurt me too.
Don't touch again.

lines.zh: 再碰我，我就拿脑袋顶你。
lines.en: Touch me again and I'll butt you with my head.
I can't hurt you much, but I will bite.
The egg opened on the leaf.
My first bite was leaf.
A small larva under the leaf.
I must eat fast to grow.

lines.zh: 平原的树上多了一张嘴
lines.en: One more mouth on the plains trees.
I chewed my first hole.
My body is still damp.
I grip the vein to steady myself.
Birds about; I must hide.
This leaf is mine from today.
The leaf caught fire; I crawled away fast.
A drop of water swallowed me.
The blast flipped the leaves.

lines.zh: 一支箭把我的叶子钉住了
lines.en: An arrow pinned my leaf.
I'm numb and can't move.

lines.zh: 我不在叶子上，快饿死了
lines.en: I'm off the leaves and starving.

lines.zh: 雷光透过叶子，我一动不动
lines.en: Lightning flashed through the leaf; I froze.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，什么都抓不到
lines.en: I'm falling with nothing to grip.
